issue.title: Agents tab Archive view retires Artifacts ▸ Agent
issue.description: Every agent that ran on this machine can be found and read on the Agents tab. The Inbox stays exactly as it is today. A new Archive view (`,a`) lists dismissed runs by day and opens any of them read-only in the real decks. Restoring is one deliberate `⏎`. Every `agent:` route lands on the Agents tab. The Artifacts ▸ Agent sub-tab is retired behind a sunset flag.

payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE (sase-1jm.3.1.8 land agent, master 791c1797b9): every AceApp startup imports the Archive modules even with the agents_archive_view beta off. actions/_state_init_runtime.py:init_runtime_state (since 69f647d912, sase-1jm.3.1) calls init_agents_archive_view_state, which imports actions.agents._archive_view, models.agent_archive_view (module-level) and _archive_controller, loads the Archive grouping preference, and initializes the controller. So sase-1jm.3.1.8's static import deferral (both modules are off the sase.ace.tui.app closure) gives no runtime startup saving; a verifier's mounted probe confirmed both modules are in sys.modules after startup. Remediation: lazy-init _agents_archive_view on first Archive access (agents_archive_is_active already tolerates the missing attribute), or skip init entirely while the beta is off, without breaking the Archive prewarm budget (warm ,a < 100 ms). Can wait for the retire-pane phase that removes the beta flag.
